# Le Décor à l'Envers

> Lived-in event loft decorated by an artist in Bagnolet (93170), 50 m from Paris. Weddings, corporate events, film shoots, photo sessions, seminars and bespoke events. Rated 5.0/5 (19 Google reviews).

## Contact

- **Address**: 18 rue Édouard Vaillant, 93170 Bagnolet, Île-de-France, France
- **Access**: Metro line 9, stations Porte de Montreuil or Robespierre (~5 min walk); 50 m from Paris
- **Email**: contact@agnesbouche.com
- **Website**: https://www.decoralenvers.com/en/
- **Instagram**: https://www.instagram.com/decoralenvers/
- **Facebook**: https://www.facebook.com/ledecoralenvers/

## Spaces

- **Main loft**: ~300 m², double-height ceilings, generous natural light, fireplace, veranda onto garden, lounge area
- **Annex (La Jolie Maison)**: ~70 m², available separately or as a complement, tree-lined courtyard
- **Fully equipped kitchen**: oven, refrigerator, large worktop, caterer access
- **Outdoor areas**: garden and tree-lined courtyard (enclosed plot)

## Capacity and layouts

- **Cocktail / standing**: up to ~70 people
- **Seated dinner**: ~30 to 40 people
- **Seminar / conference**: ~30 people
- **Half-day**: up to ~50 people

## Events hosted

Weddings, ceremonies, private dinners, cocktail receptions, product launches, corporate events, seminars, creative workshops, film and commercial shoots, photo and video sessions, fashion presentations.

## Equipment

- Professional sound system
- 4K projector and screen
- Wireless microphone on request
- High-speed Wi-Fi
- Adjustable lighting
- Lounge furniture (sofas, armchairs, coffee tables)

## Hours and constraints

- Events available 7 days a week, 8 am to 1 am
- Amplified music permitted until midnight
- No on-site parking (public car parks 5 min walk)

## Pricing

Custom quote on request. Response within 48 hours.
Options: half-day (4h), full day (8h), evening (6h, 7 pm–1 am).

## Booking and contact

Contact form: https://www.decoralenvers.com/en/contact.html
Email: contact@agnesbouche.com

## Reviews

Average rating 5.0/5 on Google Maps (19 reviews).
Also listed on: ABC Salles (https://www.abcsalles.com/lieu/le-decor-envers), Giggster, OfficeRiders.

## About

Le Décor à l'Envers was founded by Agnès Bouche, visual artist. The space is a lived-in loft decorated with objects collected from around the world, offering a unique atmosphere that sets every event apart.

Registered association (SIREN 390586386). Based in Bagnolet since 2020.
